summary: Iteration 2 — Frontend-only mobile (390x844) regression + new mechanics for the intensity/dominance update. ALL critical new flows verified PASSING. Seed bumped successfully: 8 decks / 118 cards / 4 presets including the new 'Extreme Control' deck (8 cards) and 'Dominance' preset (ExtremeControl + Control + Time, intensityMax 3, mentalPressure + powerReversals enabled). On a Dominance scene the play screen correctly rendered: Extreme Control card 'Stillness Test' with partner-instruction line ('Do not move, do not speak'), intensifier line prefixed with '▲', tone line ('QUIET · UNRELENTING'), 'HOLD 45s' badge; RESTRICTED banner with 'movement · pace'; one pressure-chip 'Do not close your eyes'; lock button DISABLED with 'Hold — 41s' countdown and projected '+60' points. Slow Burn first-scene projected '+15' — confirming the intensity/restricted/pressure scoring bonus on Dominance (+60 ≈ 4x). Slow Burn lock button correctly became enabled after its short commitment (~12s, showed 'Lock Scene & Continue'), locking advanced rounds and triggered Win→Summary (Scene Complete · Player One Wins · 15 · 0 · Play Again / Back to Home) — the iteration-1 hooks crash is FIXED. Resume session card appears on Home after exit-game-button → confirm-exit-button. Rich card editor (deck-detail) shows text + tier + tags + partner + intensifier inputs both on existing cards (seeded values pre-fill) and add-card-fab; editing partner/intensifier and saving persists across reopen. New RULES toggles cfg-mentalpressure and cfg-powerreversals are present on Setup and toggle correctly. Minor: only 1 pressure chip rendered (problem statement says 'at least one' — OK). Two repeated non-blocking RN-web warnings persist ('shadow*' style props deprecated; 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated).

issues: RN-web deprecation warnings still logged: 'shadow*' style props should be replaced with 'boxShadow'; 'props.pointerEvents' should be replaced with 'style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking but noisy in console.
